units.source_text: ……千重子有三点忘了问苗子，那就是千重子还是婴儿时就被抛弃，为什么父母抛弃她，而不抛弃苗子？

en.t: ... Chieko had forgotten to ask Naeko three things: since Chieko had been abandoned when she was still an infant, why had their parents abandoned her, and not abandoned Naeko?

units.source_text: 父亲是什么时候从杉树上摔下来的？

en.t: When had their father fallen from the cedar tree?

units.source_text: 苗子虽说是在她“刚生下来不久”，可是……

en.t: Naeko had said it was when she was "not long after being born," but...

units.source_text: 苗子还说过，她好像是在母亲的老家—比杉村更远的深山里出生的，那是什么地方呢？

en.t: Naeko had also said that she seemed to have been born at their mother's old home, deep in the mountains even farther away than Sugimura; what place was that?
